links.outcome: Flesch Reading Ease of LLM-generated vitiligo patient education responses
links.effect: Mean Flesch Reading Ease was 34.92 ± 12.28 for ChatGPT and 31.40 ± 13.33 for Gemini (P = 0.41); most responses were difficult to read.
links.quote: The mean Flesch Reading Ease scores for ChatGPT and Gemini were 34.92 ± 12.28 and 31.40 ± 13.33, respectively (P = 0.41).

links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated patient education content in plain language
links.effect: Mean Flesch Reading Ease scores were 34.92 (ChatGPT) and 31.40 (Gemini), indicating most responses were difficult to read despite high comprehensibility ratings by raters.
links.quote: ChatGPT and Gemini provided largely accurate and useful information on vitiligo; however, most responses were difficult to read.

screen.reason: Evaluates the quality, readability, and completeness of patient education content generated by ChatGPT and Gemini for vitiligo without evaluating an organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
